items.briefing:
Home batteries and solar systems are increasingly being flagged as a cybersecurity compliance concern for Australian organisations. If your workplace uses these energy systems, they may now fall under security and regulatory obligations — worth checking with your IT or facilities team.

Separately, AI tools are creating new challenges for traditional security controls, with experts warning that AI agents can stretch existing protections in unexpected ways. As AI becomes more common in daily workflows, staff should be cautious about what data they share with AI tools and report any unusual behaviour.

**Tip:** If you use AI assistants at work, avoid entering sensitive organisational information unless it's an approved tool.

featured.title: Australia's home batteries are now a cybersecurity compliance isue
featured.summary: Millions of rooftop batteries are now subject to mandatory cyber standards as Canberra widens scrutiny of grid-connected home devices.
